    61	
    62	type runSnapshot struct {
    63		runRaw json.RawMessage
    64		run    apiRun
    65		events []sseEvent
    66	}
    67	
    68	// loadAgentSnapshot reads an agent directory. A directory without agent.json
    69	// is not an agent yet (a refresh writes agent.json last) and yields nil.
    70	func loadAgentSnapshot(dir string) (*agentSnapshot, error) {
    71		agentRaw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "agent.json"))
    72		if err != nil {
    73			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
    74				return nil, nil
    75			}
    76			return nil, err
    77		}
    78		record, err := decodeAgent(agentRaw)
    79		if err != nil {
    80			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", filepath.Join(dir, "agent.json"), err)
    81		}
    82		snap := &agentSnapshot{dir: dir, agentRaw: record.raw, agent: record.agent}
    83	
    84		if raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "conversation.json")); err == nil {
    85			var conv v0Conversation
    86			if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal(raw, &conv); jsonErr != nil {
    87				slog.Warn("Ignoring undecodable conversation", "path", filepath.Join(dir, "conversation.json"), "error", jsonErr)
    88			} else {
    89				snap.conversationRaw = raw
    90				snap.conversation = &conv
    91			}
    92		}
    93		if raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "usage.json")); err == nil && json.Valid(raw) {
    94			snap.usageRaw = raw
    95		}
    96	
    97		runsDir := filepath.Join(dir, "runs")
    98		entries, err := os.ReadDir(runsDir)
    99		if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) {
   100			return nil, err
   101		}
   102		for _, entry := range entries {
   103			name := entry.Name()
   104			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") {
   105				continue
   106			}
   107			raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(runsDir, name))
   108			if err != nil {
   109				return nil, err
   110			}
   111			record, err := decodeRun(raw)
   112			if err != nil {
   113				slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable run", "path", filepath.Join(runsDir, name), "error", err)
   114				continue
   115			}
   116			events, err := readEventsFile(filepath.Join(runsDir, record.run.ID+".events.jsonl"))
   117			if err != nil {
   118				return nil, err
   119			}
   120			snap.runs = append(snap.runs, runSnapshot{runRaw: record.raw, run: record.run, events: events})
   121		}
   122		// One run is one exchange in creation order. The API lists runs newest
   123		// first; the id breaks ties so the order never depends on directory order.
   124		sort.SliceStable(snap.runs, func(i, j int) bool {
   125			a, b := snap.runs[i].run, snap.runs[j].run
   126			if a.CreatedAt != b.CreatedAt {
   127				return a.CreatedAt < b.CreatedAt
   128			}
   129			return a.ID < b.ID
   130		})
   131		return snap, nil
   132	}
   133	
   134	// agentDirs lists the agent directories in the mirror, sorted by id.
   135	func (m mirror) agentDirs() ([]string, error) {
   136		entries, err := os.ReadDir(filepath.Join(m.root, "agents"))
   137		if err != nil {
   138			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   139				return nil, nil
   140			}
   141			return nil, err
   142		}
   143		var dirs []string
   144		for _, entry := range entries {
   145			if entry.IsDir() && validAgentID(entry.Name()) {
   146				dirs = append(dirs, filepath.Join(m.root, "agents", entry.Name()))
   147			}
   148		}
   149		return dirs, nil
   150	}
   151	
   152	// readStoredAgent returns the mirrored agent object, or nil when absent.
   153	func (m mirror) readStoredAgent(agentID string) *apiAgent {
   154		raw, err := os.ReadFile(m.agentFile(agentID))
   155		if err != nil {
   156			return nil
   157		}
   158		record, err := decodeAgent(raw)
   159		if err != nil {
   160			return nil
   161		}
   162		return &record.agent
   163	}
   164	
   165	// ensureRoot creates the mirror root and, for a mirror inside the project,
   166	// the .gitignore that keeps raw transcripts out of commits.
   167	func (m mirror) ensureRoot(projectLocal bool) error {
   168		if err := os.MkdirAll(m.root, 0o755); err != nil {
   169			return err
   170		}
   171		if !projectLocal {
   172			return nil
   173		}
   174		path := filepath.Join(m.root, ".gitignore")
   175		if existing, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil && gitignoreExcludesAll(existing) {
   176			return nil
   177		}
   178		return writeFileAtomic(path, []byte(mirrorGitignore))
   179	}
   180	
   181	// gitignoreExcludesAll reports whether a .gitignore carries the bare "*" rule
   182	// the mirror relies on. A file that exists without it (edited, truncated) would
   183	// let git track raw transcripts, so ensureRoot rewrites it rather than trusting
   184	// its presence.
   185	func gitignoreExcludesAll(content []byte) bool {
   186		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(content), "\n") {
   187			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "*" {
   188				return true
   189			}
   190		}
   191		return false
   192	}
   193	
   194	// writeFileAtomic replaces path with data via a temporary file and a rename, so
   195	// a concurrent reader sees the old file or the new one, never a torn write.
   196	// An unchanged file is left alone, which keeps the directory fingerprint (and
   197	// so reindex) stable across syncs that bring nothing new.
   198	func writeFileAtomic(path string, data []byte) error {
   199		if existing, err := os.ReadFile(path); err == nil && bytes.Equal(existing, data) {
   200			return nil
   201		}
   202		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
   203			return err
   204		}
   205		tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(path), "."+filepath.Base(path)+".tmp-*")
   206		if err != nil {
   207			return err
   208		}
   209		tmpName := tmp.Name()
   210		if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
   211			_ = tmp.Close()
   212			_ = os.Remove(tmpName)
   213			return err
   214		}
   215		if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
   216			_ = os.Remove(tmpName)
   217			return err
   218		}
   219		if err := os.Rename(tmpName, path); err != nil {
   220			_ = os.Remove(tmpName)
   221			return err
   222		}
   223		return nil
   224	}
   225	
   226	// writeEvents stores a run's events atomically.
   227	func (m mirror) writeEvents(agentID, runID string, events []sseEvent) error {
   228		data, err := encodeEvents(events)
   229		if err != nil {
   230			return err
   231		}
   232		return writeFileAtomic(m.eventsFile(agentID, runID), data)
   233	}
   234	
   235	// refreshOptions tunes a refresh for its caller.
   236	type refreshOptions struct {
   237		// skipStreams names runs whose events another goroutine is writing (a live
   238		// attach); the refresh must not replace their files underneath it.
   239		skipStreams map[string]bool
   240		now         time.Time
   241	}
   242	
   243	// refreshAgent brings one agent's mirror up to date. Runs, conversation and
   244	// usage are re-fetched only when agent.updatedAt differs from what the mirror
   245	// holds. Streams are fetched for finished runs whose capture is missing or
   246	// partial while the API still retains them; a whole capture is never
   247	// re-fetched. Unfinished runs are not streamed here, because reading a live
   248	// stream blocks until the run ends; the watcher attaches to those instead.
   249	// agent.json is written last so an interrupted refresh is retried next time.
   250	func (m mirror) refreshAgent(ctx context.Context, c *apiClient, record agentRecord, opts refreshOptions) error {
   251		agentID := record.agent.ID
   252		stored := m.readStoredAgent(agentID)
   253		changed := stored == nil || stored.UpdatedAt != record.agent.UpdatedAt
   254	
   255		if changed {
   256			runs, err := c.listRuns(ctx, agentID)
   257			if err != nil {
   258				return fmt.Errorf("list runs: %w", err)
   259			}
   260			for _, run := range runs {
   261				if err := writeFileAtomic(m.runFile(agentID, run.run.ID), run.raw); err != nil {
   262					return err
   263				}
   264			}
   265			// A transient failure is returned so agent.json keeps its old updatedAt
   266			// and the next sync retries; a permanent refusal is logged and the agent
   267			// is mirrored without that file, since retrying would never help.
   268			if conv, err := c.conversation(ctx, agentID); err != nil {
   269				if !permanentAPIError(err) {
   270					return fmt.Errorf("fetch conversation: %w", err)
   271				}
   272				slog.Warn("Conversation unavailable for this agent", "agentId", agentID, "error", err)
   273			} else if err := writeFileAtomic(filepath.Join(m.agentDir(agentID), "conversation.json"), conv); err != nil {
   274				return err
   275			}
   276			if usage, err := c.usage(ctx, agentID); err != nil {
   277				if !permanentAPIError(err) {
   278					return fmt.Errorf("fetch usage: %w", err)
   279				}
   280				slog.Warn("Usage unavailable for this agent", "agentId", agentID, "error", err)
   281			} else if err := writeFileAtomic(filepath.Join(m.agentDir(agentID), "usage.json"), usage); err != nil {
   282				return err
   283			}
   284		}
   285	
   286		if err := m.fetchMissingStreams(ctx, c, agentID, opts); err != nil {
   287			return err
   288		}
   289	
   290		if changed {
   291			return writeFileAtomic(m.agentFile(agentID), record.raw)
   292		}
   293		return nil
   294	}
   295	
   296	// fetchMissingStreams replays the stream of every finished run whose mirrored
   297	// capture is not whole, while the API still retains it.
   298	func (m mirror) fetchMissingStreams(ctx context.Context, c *apiClient, agentID string, opts refreshOptions) error {
   299		entries, err := os.ReadDir(m.runsDir(agentID))
   300		if err != nil {
   301			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   302				return nil
   303			}
   304			return err
   305		}
   306		for _, entry := range entries {
   307			name := entry.Name()
   308			if entry.IsDir() || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".json") {
   309				continue
   310			}
   311			raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(m.runsDir(agentID), name))
   312			if err != nil {
   313				return err
   314			}
   315			record, err := decodeRun(raw)
   316			if err != nil {
   317				continue
   318			}
   319			run := record.run
   320			if !run.isTerminal() || opts.skipStreams[run.ID] || !withinRetention(run, opts.now) {
   321				continue
   322			}
   323			events, err := readEventsFile(m.eventsFile(agentID, run.ID))
   324			if err != nil {
   325				return err
   326			}
   327			if eventsAreWhole(events) {
   328				continue
   329			}
   330			replayed, err := replayStream(ctx, c, agentID, run.ID)
   331			if errors.Is(err, errStreamExpired) {
   332				// Expired after all (clock skew or an early purge): the partial
   333				// capture stays and the v0 conversation fills the exchange.
   334				slog.Debug("Run stream expired; keeping partial capture", "agentId", agentID, "runId", run.ID)
   335				continue
   336			}
   337			if err != nil {
   338				return fmt.Errorf("replay stream %s: %w", run.ID, err)
   339			}
   340			if err := m.writeEvents(agentID, run.ID, replayed); err != nil {
   341				return err
   342			}
   343		}
   344		return nil
   345	}
   346	
   347	// withinRetention reports whether a finished run's stream should still be
   348	// replayable. now is wall-clock time; this decides whether to make a network
   349	// call and never reaches rendered output.
   350	func withinRetention(run apiRun, now time.Time) bool {
   351		ended, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, run.UpdatedAt)
   352		if err != nil {
   353			// Without a parseable end time, trying is cheaper than losing the transcript.
   354			return true
   355		}
   356		return now.Sub(ended) < streamRetention
   357	}
   358	
   359	// replayStream reads a finished run's stream from the start to its done event.
   360	func replayStream(ctx context.Context, c *apiClient, agentID, runID string) ([]sseEvent, error) {
   361		body, err := c.openStream(ctx, agentID, runID, "")
   362		if err != nil {
   363			return nil, err
   364		}
   365		defer func() { _ = body.Close() }()
   366		var events []sseEvent
   367		err = readSSE(body, agentID+"/"+runID, func(ev sseEvent) bool {
   368			events = append(events, ev)
   369			return ev.Event != "done"
   370		})
   371		if err != nil {
   372			return nil, err
   373		}
   374		return events, nil
   375	}
   376	
   377	// agentDirFingerprint sums sizes and takes the newest mtime across an agent
   378	// directory: one file (agent.json) does not change when a run's events land.
   379	func agentDirFingerprint(dir string) *spi.SessionFingerprint {
   380		fp := &spi.SessionFingerprint{}
   381		_ = filepath.WalkDir(dir, func(path string, d os.DirEntry, err error) error {
   382			if err != nil || d.IsDir() {
   383				return nil
   384			}
   385			info, err := d.Info()
   386			if err != nil {
   387				return nil
   388			}
   389			fp.Size += info.Size()
   390			if mt := info.ModTime().UnixNano(); mt > fp.Mtime {
   391				fp.Mtime = mt
   392			}
   393			return nil
   394		})
   395		return fp
   396	}
     1	package cursorcloud
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"log/slog"
     5		"os"
     6		"path/filepath"
     7		"strings"
     8	
     9		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
    10	)
    11	
    12	// apiKeyEnvVar is the environment variable Cursor's own tooling reads the API
    13	// key from; it overrides the config file so a one-off key needs no edit.
    14	const apiKeyEnvVar = "CURSOR_API_KEY"
    15	
    16	// Settings handed in by the CLI at startup. Each is set once before any
    17	// provider method runs, so no locking is needed.
    18	var (
    19		configAPIKey        string
    20		configMirrorDir     string
    21		userDataDirOverride string
    22	)
    23	
    24	// SetAPIKey sets the key from `cursor_api_key` in specstory.toml. The
    25	// CURSOR_API_KEY environment variable still wins when set.
    26	func SetAPIKey(key string) {
    27		configAPIKey = strings.TrimSpace(key)
    28	}
    29	
    30	// SetMirrorDir sets the mirror location from `cursorcloud_mirror_dir` in
    31	// specstory.toml (tilde-expanded). Empty keeps the project-local default.
    32	func SetMirrorDir(dir string) {
    33		configMirrorDir = expandHome(strings.TrimSpace(dir))
    34	}
    35	
    36	// SetUserDataDirOverride sets the mirror location from
    37	// `--user-data-dir cursorcloud:<path>`, which wins over the config file.
    38	func SetUserDataDirOverride(dir string) {
    39		userDataDirOverride = expandHome(strings.TrimSpace(dir))
    40	}
    41	
    42	// resolveAPIKey returns the key and where it came from ("" when none).
    43	func resolveAPIKey() (key, source string) {
    44		if env := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(apiKeyEnvVar)); env != "" {
    45			return env, apiKeyEnvVar
    46		}
    47		if configAPIKey != "" {
    48			return configAPIKey, "cursor_api_key"
    49		}
    50		return "", ""
    51	}
    52	
    53	// mirrorFor returns the mirror for a project and whether it lives inside the
    54	// project, which decides whether ensureRoot writes the protective .gitignore.
    55	// The override and config locations are shared by every project and usually
    56	// sit outside it; the default keeps each project's mirror next to its history.
    57	// Locality is decided from the resolved path, not from which setting supplied
    58	// it, because a configured path such as ".specstory/cursorcloud" still writes
    59	// unredacted transcripts into the project and still needs the .gitignore.
    60	func mirrorFor(projectPath string) (mirror, bool) {
    61		root := userDataDirOverride
    62		if root == "" {
    63			root = configMirrorDir
    64		}
    65		if root == "" {
    66			return mirror{root: filepath.Join(projectPath, ".specstory", "cursorcloud")}, true
    67		}
    68		root = canonicalMirrorRoot(root)
    69		return mirror{root: root}, insideProject(root, projectPath)
    70	}
    71	
    72	// canonicalMirrorRoot resolves a configured root to an absolute path with
    73	// symlinks evaluated. Session refs carry mirror paths as NativePath, which must
    74	// be absolute so a resume from another directory still finds them, and the
    75	// locality check must see where a symlink really points. The directory may not
    76	// exist yet (ensureRoot creates it), so the nearest existing ancestor is
    77	// resolved and the missing tail re-appended.
    78	func canonicalMirrorRoot(path string) string {
    79		abs, err := filepath.Abs(path)
    80		if err != nil {
    81			return filepath.Clean(path)
    82		}
    83		tail := ""
    84		for dir := abs; ; {
    85			if _, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil {
    86				return filepath.Join(spi.CanonicalizePathOrClean(dir), tail)
    87			}
    88			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
    89			if parent == dir {
    90				return abs
    91			}
    92			tail = filepath.Join(filepath.Base(dir), tail)
    93			dir = parent
    94		}
    95	}
    96	
    97	// insideProject reports whether root, already canonical, lies strictly below
    98	// projectPath. The project root itself does not count: a "*" .gitignore there
    99	// would hide the whole project from git, which is worse than an unprotected
   100	// mirror, so that misconfiguration is left to the user.
   101	func insideProject(root, projectPath string) bool {
   102		if projectPath == "" {
   103			return false
   104		}
   105		rel, err := filepath.Rel(spi.CanonicalizePathOrClean(projectPath), root)
   106		if err != nil || rel == "." || rel == ".." || filepath.IsAbs(rel) {
   107			return false
   108		}
   109		return !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
   110	}
   111	
   112	// globalMirror is the mirror enumerated by reindex, which has no project: the
   113	// shared location when one is configured, else the current project's mirror.
   114	func globalMirror() mirror {
   115		if userDataDirOverride != "" || configMirrorDir != "" {
   116			m, _ := mirrorFor("")
   117			return m
   118		}
   119		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
   120		if err != nil {
   121			slog.Warn("ListAllAgentChatSessions: cannot resolve working directory", "error", err)
   122			return mirror{}
   123		}
   124		m, _ := mirrorFor(spi.CanonicalizePathOrClean(cwd))
   125		return m
   126	}
   127	
   128	// projectOrigin returns the normalized origin URL of the project's repository,
   129	// or "" when the project has none. Agents are matched to projects by
   130	// repository, because the API records a repository and never a directory.
   131	func projectOrigin(projectPath string) string {
   132		origin := spi.GitOriginURL(projectPath)
   133		if origin == "" {
   134			return ""
   135		}
   136		return spi.NormalizeGitRemoteURL(origin)
   137	}
   138	
   139	// agentMatchesOrigin reports whether any of the agent's repositories is the
   140	// project's origin.
   141	func agentMatchesOrigin(agent apiAgent, origin string) bool {
   142		if origin == "" {
   143			return false
   144		}
   145		for _, repo := range agent.Repos {
   146			if spi.NormalizeGitRemoteURL(repo.URL) == origin {
   147				return true
   148			}
   149		}
   150		return false
   151	}
   152	
   153	// workspaceRootFor is the SessionData workspace root: the caller's project,
   154	// else the process working directory as the documented last resort.
   155	func workspaceRootFor(projectPath string) string {
   156		if projectPath != "" {
   157			return projectPath
   158		}
   159		if cwd, err := os.Getwd(); err == nil {
   160			return cwd
   161		}
   162		return "."
   163	}
   164	
   165	// expandHome expands a leading ~ so config and flag values can use it.
   166	func expandHome(path string) string {
   167		if path != "~" && !strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") && !strings.HasPrefix(path, `~\`) {
   168			return path
   169		}
   170		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
   171		if err != nil {
   172			return path
   173		}
   174		return filepath.Join(home, strings.TrimLeft(path[1:], `/\`))
   175	}

    66		"token-delta", "text-delta", "thinking-delta", "thinking-completed",
    67		"step-started", "step-completed", "tool-call-started", "tool-call-completed",
    68		"tool-requests-listed", "partial-tool-call", "turn-ended",
    69	}
    70	
    71	// parseRunEvents folds a run's events, in stream order, into a transcript.
    72	func parseRunEvents(events []sseEvent, source string) runTranscript {
    73		var t runTranscript
    74		calls := map[string]*toolCall{}
    75	
    76		for i, ev := range events {
    77			ts := eventTime(ev.ID)
    78			if t.startTime == "" && ts != "" {
    79				t.startTime = ts
    80			}
    81			switch ev.Event {
    82			case "status", "heartbeat", "done":
    83				// status opens and closes a run (the run object carries it), heartbeat
    84				// keeps a quiet live stream open, done marks the end of the stream.
    85			case "interaction_update":
    86				var update struct {
    87					Type        string `json:"type"`
    88					UserMessage struct {
    89						Text string `json:"text"`
    90					} `json:"userMessage"`
    91				}
    92				if err := json.Unmarshal(ev.Data, &update); err != nil {
    93					slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable stream event", "source", source, "index", i, "event", ev.Event, "error", err)
    94					continue
    95				}
    96				switch {
    97				case update.Type == "user-message-appended":
    98					// The run's prompt; the only place the stream records it.
    99					t.userText = update.UserMessage.Text
   100					t.userTime = ts
   101				case slices.Contains(interactionTypesWithoutContent, update.Type):
   102				default:
   103					slog.Debug("Unknown interaction_update type", "source", source, "type", update.Type)
   104				}
   105			case "thinking", "assistant":
   106				var delta struct {
   107					Text string `json:"text"`
   108				}
   109				if err := json.Unmarshal(ev.Data, &delta); err != nil {
   110					slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable stream event", "source", source, "index", i, "event", ev.Event, "error", err)
   111					continue
   112				}
   113				kind := segmentText
   114				if ev.Event == "thinking" {
   115					kind = segmentThinking
   116				}
   117				t.appendDelta(kind, delta.Text, ts)
   118			case "tool_call":
   119				t.mergeToolCall(calls, ev, ts, source, i)
   120			case "result":
   121				// The result text repeats the last assistant text, so only its time is used.
   122				t.resultTime = ts
   123			default:
   124				slog.Debug("Unknown stream event", "source", source, "event", ev.Event)
   125			}
   126		}
   127		return t
   128	}
   129	
   130	// appendDelta extends the current segment when it is of the same kind, so
   131	// consecutive deltas become one part, and opens a new segment otherwise.
   132	func (t *runTranscript) appendDelta(kind segmentKind, text, ts string) {
   133		if n := len(t.segments); n > 0 && t.segments[n-1].kind == kind {
   134			t.segments[n-1].text.WriteString(text)
   135			return
   136		}
   137		seg := &segment{kind: kind, time: ts}
   138		seg.text.WriteString(text)
   139		t.segments = append(t.segments, seg)
   140	}
   141	
   142	// mergeToolCall applies one tool_call event. A call is placed where its first
   143	// event appears; later events update it field by field, so the last event
   144	// wins. A result on a "running" event is provisional: the stream attaches a
   145	// placeholder error ("Invalid arguments") while arguments are still streaming
   146	// and replaces it when the call completes, so only results from other
   147	// statuses are kept.
   148	func (t *runTranscript) mergeToolCall(calls map[string]*toolCall, ev sseEvent, ts, source string, index int) {
   149		var payload struct {
   150			CallID string          `json:"callId"`
   151			Name   string          `json:"name"`
   152			Status string          `json:"status"`
   153			Args   json.RawMessage `json:"args"`
   154			Result json.RawMessage `json:"result"`
   155		}
   156		if err := json.Unmarshal(ev.Data, &payload); err != nil || payload.CallID == "" {
   157			slog.Warn("Skipping undecodable tool_call event", "source", source, "index", index, "error", err)
   158			return
   159		}
   160		call, seen := calls[payload.CallID]
   161		if !seen {
   162			call = &toolCall{callID: payload.CallID, time: ts}
   163			calls[payload.CallID] = call
   164			t.segments = append(t.segments, &segment{kind: segmentTool, time: ts, call: call})
   165		}
   166		if payload.Name != "" {
   167			call.name = payload.Name
   168		}
   169		if payload.Status != "" {
   170			call.status = payload.Status
   171		}
   172		if len(payload.Args) > 0 {
   173			var args map[string]any
   174			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload.Args, &args); err == nil {
   175				call.args = args
   176			}
   177		}
   178		if len(payload.Result) > 0 && payload.Status != "running" {
   179			var result map[string]any
   180			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload.Result, &result); err == nil {
   181				call.result = result
   182			}
   183		}
   184	}
   185	
   186	// buildSessionData converts a mirrored agent into SessionData. It returns nil
   187	// when no run yields a user prompt, which means there is nothing to save yet.
   188	func buildSessionData(snap *agentSnapshot, workspaceRoot string) (*schema.SessionData, string) {
   189		agent := snap.agent
   190		data := &schema.SessionData{
   191			SchemaVersion: schema.CurrentSchemaVersion,
   192			// The API exposes no agent version, so the honest value is "unknown".
   193			Provider:      schema.ProviderInfo{ID: ProviderID, Name: providerName, Version: "unknown"},
   194			SessionID:     agent.ID,
   195			CreatedAt:     agent.CreatedAt,
   196			UpdatedAt:     agent.UpdatedAt,
   197			WorkspaceRoot: workspaceRoot,
   198			Exchanges:     []schema.Exchange{},
   199		}
   200	
   201		firstPrompt := ""
   202		for i, run := range snap.runs {
   203			exchange := buildExchange(snap, i, run, workspaceRoot)
   204			if exchange == nil {
   205				continue
   206			}
   207			if firstPrompt == "" {
   208				firstPrompt = firstUserText(exchange)
   209			}
   210			data.Exchanges = append(data.Exchanges, *exchange)
   211		}
   212		if firstPrompt == "" {
   213			return nil, ""
   214		}
   215		data.Slug = spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(firstPrompt)
   216		return data, firstPrompt
   217	}
   218	
   219	// buildExchange builds one run's exchange. The stream is the full-fidelity
   220	// source; the v0 conversation (text only) fills in when the stream is missing,
   221	// or when a finished run's capture is partial and the stream has since expired.
   222	func buildExchange(snap *agentSnapshot, index int, run runSnapshot, workspaceRoot string) *schema.Exchange {
   223		source := snap.dir + "/runs/" + run.run.ID
   224		useStream := len(run.events) > 0
   225		if useStream && run.run.isTerminal() && !eventsAreWhole(run.events) && len(v0TurnMessages(snap.conversation, index)) > 0 {
   226			useStream = false
   227		}
   228	
   229		var exchange *schema.Exchange
   230		if useStream {
   231			exchange = exchangeFromStream(parseRunEvents(run.events, source), run, workspaceRoot)
   232		}
   233		if exchange == nil {
   234			exchange = exchangeFromConversation(snap.conversation, index, run)
   235		}
   236		if exchange == nil {
   237			slog.Debug("Run has no recorded content yet", "agentId", snap.agent.ID, "runId", run.run.ID)
   238			return nil
   239		}
   240		exchange.Metadata = exchangeMetadata(snap.agent, run.run, exchange.Metadata)
   241		return exchange
   242	}
   243	
   244	// exchangeFromStream turns a transcript into messages: the prompt, then agent
   245	// messages in stream order. Thinking and text share one agent message until a
   246	// tool call interrupts; each tool call is its own message.
   247	func exchangeFromStream(t runTranscript, run runSnapshot, workspaceRoot string) *schema.Exchange {
   248		if t.userText == "" && len(t.segments) == 0 {
   249			return nil
   250		}
   251		runID := run.run.ID
   252		exchange := &schema.Exchange{ExchangeID: runID, StartTime: t.startTime, EndTime: t.resultTime}
   253	
   254		if t.userText != "" {
   255			userTime := t.userTime
   256			if userTime == "" {
   257				userTime = run.run.CreatedAt
   258			}
   259			exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, schema.Message{
   260				ID:        runID + ":user",
   261				Timestamp: userTime,
   262				Role:      schema.RoleUser,
   263				Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: t.userText}},
   264			})
   265		}
   266	
   267		var current *schema.Message
   268		flush := func() {
   269			if current != nil && len(current.Content) > 0 {
   270				exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, *current)
   271			}
   272			current = nil
   273		}
   274		for _, seg := range t.segments {
   275			switch seg.kind {
   276			case segmentThinking, segmentText:
   277				text := seg.text.String()
   278				if strings.TrimSpace(text) == "" {
   279					continue
   280				}
   281				if current == nil {
   282					current = &schema.Message{
   283						ID:        runID + ":" + strconv.Itoa(len(exchange.Messages)),
   284						Timestamp: seg.time,
   285						Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
   286					}
   287				}
   288				partType := schema.ContentTypeText
   289				if seg.kind == segmentThinking {
   290					partType = schema.ContentTypeThinking
   291				}
   292				current.Content = append(current.Content, schema.ContentPart{Type: partType, Text: text})
   293			case segmentTool:
   294				flush()
   295				exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, toolMessage(seg.call, workspaceRoot))
   296			}
   297		}
   298		flush()
   299		return exchange
   300	}
   301	
   302	// toolMessage converts one merged tool call.
   303	func toolMessage(call *toolCall, workspaceRoot string) schema.Message {
   304		tool := &schema.ToolInfo{
   305			Name:   call.name,
   306			Type:   toolType(call.name),
   307			UseID:  call.callID,
   308			Input:  cleanToolInput(call.args),
   309			Output: call.result,
   310		}
   311		if markdown := formatTool(tool); markdown != "" {
   312			tool.FormattedMarkdown = &markdown
   313		}
   314		msg := schema.Message{
   315			ID:        call.callID,
   316			Timestamp: call.time,
   317			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
   318			Tool:      tool,
   319			PathHints: pathHints(call.name, tool.Input, workspaceRoot),
   320		}
   321		if call.status != "" {
   322			msg.Metadata = map[string]any{"status": call.status}
   323		}
   324		return msg
   325	}
   326	
   327	// pathHints lists the files a call wrote. Paths are recorded under the VM's
   328	// /workspace; rewriting that prefix onto the local project lets the shared
   329	// normalizer make them project-relative like every other provider's hints.
   330	func pathHints(name string, input map[string]any, workspaceRoot string) []string {
   331		var hints []string
   332		switch toolType(name) {
   333		case schema.ToolTypeWrite:
   334			if path := spi.StringValue(input, "path"); path != "" {
   335				hints = append(hints, spi.NormalizePath(localPath(path, workspaceRoot), workspaceRoot))
   336			}
   337		case schema.ToolTypeShell:
   338			command := spi.StringValue(input, "command")
   339			cwd := localPath(spi.StringValue(input, "workingDirectory"), workspaceRoot)
   340			if cwd == "" {
   341				cwd = workspaceRoot
   342			}
   343			for _, hint := range spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot) {
   344				if !slices.Contains(hints, hint) {
   345					hints = append(hints, hint)
   346				}
   347			}
   348		}
   349		return hints
   350	}
   351	
   352	// localPath maps a VM path onto the local project root. The root is joined by
   353	// shape with "/" because recorded paths are POSIX; NormalizePath accepts
   354	// either separator.
   355	func localPath(path, workspaceRoot string) string {
   356		if workspaceRoot == "" {
   357			return path
   358		}
   359		root := strings.TrimRight(workspaceRoot, `/\`)
   360		if path == vmWorkspaceRoot {
   361			return root
   362		}
   363		if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(path, vmWorkspaceRoot+"/"); ok {
   364			return root + "/" + rest
   365		}
   366		return path
   367	}
   368	
   369	// displayPath shows a VM path relative to the repository.
   370	func displayPath(path string) string {
   371		if path == vmWorkspaceRoot {
   372			return "."
   373		}
   374		if rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(path, vmWorkspaceRoot+"/"); ok {
   375			return rest
   376		}
   377		return path
   378	}
   379	
   380	// v0TurnMessages returns the v0 messages belonging to run index turn. Ids are
   381	// "turn-N:user" and "turn-N:step:M:assistant"; the agent's very first user
   382	// message has a bare UUID id and belongs to turn 0.
   383	func v0TurnMessages(conv *v0Conversation, turn int) []v0Message {
   384		if conv == nil {
   385			return nil
   386		}
   387		var out []v0Message
   388		for _, msg := range conv.Messages {
   389			if v0MessageTurn(msg.ID) == turn {
   390				out = append(out, msg)
   391			}
   392		}
   393		return out
   394	}
   395	
   396	// v0MessageTurn parses the turn index from a v0 message id.
   397	func v0MessageTurn(id string) int {
   398		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(id, "turn-")
   399		if !ok {
   400			return 0
   401		}
   402		digits, _, _ := strings.Cut(rest, ":")
   403		n, err := strconv.Atoi(digits)
   404		if err != nil {
   405			return -1
   406		}
   407		return n
   408	}
   409	
   410	// exchangeFromConversation builds a text-only exchange from the v0
   411	// conversation. v0 records no times, so the run's own times stand in.
   412	func exchangeFromConversation(conv *v0Conversation, index int, run runSnapshot) *schema.Exchange {
   413		messages := v0TurnMessages(conv, index)
   414		if len(messages) == 0 {
   415			return nil
   416		}
   417		exchange := &schema.Exchange{
   418			ExchangeID: run.run.ID,
   419			StartTime:  run.run.CreatedAt,
   420			EndTime:    run.run.UpdatedAt,
   421			Metadata:   map[string]any{"source": "v0-conversation"},
   422		}
   423		for _, msg := range messages {
   424			if strings.TrimSpace(msg.Text) == "" {
   425				continue
   426			}
   427			role := schema.RoleAgent
   428			timestamp := ""
   429			switch msg.Type {
   430			case "user_message":
   431				role = schema.RoleUser
   432				timestamp = run.run.CreatedAt
   433			case "assistant_message":
   434			default:
   435				slog.Debug("Unknown v0 message type", "type", msg.Type, "id", msg.ID)
   436			}
   437			exchange.Messages = append(exchange.Messages, schema.Message{
   438				ID:        msg.ID,
   439				Timestamp: timestamp,
   440				Role:      role,
   441				Content:   []schema.ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: msg.Text}},
   442			})
   443		}
   444		if len(exchange.Messages) == 0 {
   445			return nil
   446		}
   447		return exchange
   448	}
   449	
   450	// exchangeMetadata records what a reader wants to click: the agent page, the
   451	// branch and pull request, and how the run ended. Token usage lives in the
   452	// usage endpoint per run, not per message, so it stays in RawData rather than
   453	// being forced into the per-message Usage field.
   454	func exchangeMetadata(agent apiAgent, run apiRun, existing map[string]any) map[string]any {
   455		meta := existing
   456		if meta == nil {
   457			meta = map[string]any{}
   458		}
   459		meta["runId"] = run.ID
   460		if run.Status != "" {
   461			meta["status"] = run.Status
   462		}
   463		if run.DurationMs > 0 {
   464			meta["durationMs"] = run.DurationMs
   465		}
   466		if len(run.Git.Branches) > 0 {
   467			branch := run.Git.Branches[0]
   468			if branch.Branch != "" {
   469				meta["branch"] = branch.Branch
   470			}
   471			if branch.PrURL != "" {
   472				meta["prUrl"] = branch.PrURL
   473			}
   474		}
   475		if agent.URL != "" {
   476			meta["agentUrl"] = agent.URL
   477		}
   478		return meta
   479	}
   480	
   481	// firstUserText returns the text of an exchange's first user message.
   482	func firstUserText(exchange *schema.Exchange) string {
   483		for _, msg := range exchange.Messages {
   484			if msg.Role != schema.RoleUser {
   485				continue
   486			}
   487			for _, part := range msg.Content {
   488				if part.Type == schema.ContentTypeText && strings.TrimSpace(part.Text) != "" {
   489					return part.Text
   490				}
   491			}
   492		}
   493		return ""
   494	}
   495	
   496	// sessionName prefers the agent's own name (Cursor sets one, derived from the
   497	// prompt when the launcher gave none) over the shared generator.
   498	func sessionName(agent apiAgent, firstPrompt string) string {
   499		if name := strings.TrimSpace(agent.Name); name != "" {
   500			return name
   501		}
   502		return spi.GenerateReadableName(firstPrompt)
   503	}

   505	// rawSession is the RawData envelope: the native objects of one mirror read.
   506	type rawSession struct {
   507		Agent        json.RawMessage `json:"agent"`
   508		Runs         []rawRun        `json:"runs"`
   509		Conversation json.RawMessage `json:"conversation,omitempty"`
   510		Usage        json.RawMessage `json:"usage,omitempty"`
   511	}
   512	
   513	type rawRun struct {
   514		Run    json.RawMessage `json:"run"`
   515		Events []sseEvent      `json:"events"`
   516	}
   517	
   518	// buildRawData serializes the snapshot the session was built from, so RawData
   519	// never describes more than the converted session saw.
   520	func buildRawData(snap *agentSnapshot) (string, error) {
   521		raw := rawSession{Agent: snap.agentRaw, Conversation: snap.conversationRaw, Usage: snap.usageRaw, Runs: []rawRun{}}
   522		for _, run := range snap.runs {
   523			events := run.events
   524			if events == nil {
   525				events = []sseEvent{}
   526			}
   527			raw.Runs = append(raw.Runs, rawRun{Run: run.runRaw, Events: events})
   528		}
   529		data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
   530		if err != nil {
   531			return "", fmt.Errorf("marshal raw data: %w", err)
   532		}
   533		return string(data), nil
   534	}

   113	}

   115	// sseEvent is one SSE block as the mirror stores it: one JSON object per line
   116	// of a run's events file.
   117	type sseEvent struct {
   118		ID    string          `json:"id,omitempty"`
   119		Event string          `json:"event"`
   120		Data  json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   121	}
   122	
   123	// maxSSELineSize caps one SSE line, and so one block. A variable so tests can
   124	// exercise the oversized path without allocating 64MB.
   125	var maxSSELineSize = spi.MaxRecordLineSize
   126	
   127	// readSSE parses an SSE byte stream, calling emit for each complete block in
   128	// order. A block holding an oversized line is skipped with a warning rather
   129	// than ending the stream. Comment lines (": keepalive") are ignored. emit
   130	// returning false stops the read early (used once the done event arrives).
   131	func readSSE(r io.Reader, source string, emit func(sseEvent) bool) error {
   132		reader := bufio.NewReader(r)
   133		var id, event string
   134		var data strings.Builder
   135		hasData, skipBlock := false, false
   136		lineNo := 0
   137	
   138		dispatch := func() bool {
   139			defer func() {
   140				id, event = "", ""
   141				data.Reset()
   142				hasData, skipBlock = false, false
   143			}()
   144			if skipBlock {
   145				slog.Warn("Skipping oversized SSE block", "source", source, "line", lineNo)
   146				return true
   147			}
   148			if event == "" && !hasData {
   149				return true
   150			}
   151			if event == "" {
   152				// The SSE default event type; never observed from this API.
   153				event = "message"
   154			}
   155			return emit(sseEvent{ID: id, Event: event, Data: sseData(data.String(), hasData)})
   156		}
   157	
   158		for {
   159			line, oversized, err := spi.ReadRecordLine(reader, maxSSELineSize)
   160			if len(line) > 0 || oversized {
   161				lineNo++
   162			}
   163			if oversized {
   164				skipBlock = true
   165			} else if len(line) > 0 || err == nil {
   166				text := strings.TrimRight(string(line), "\r\n")
   167				if text == "" {
   168					if !dispatch() {
   169						return nil
   170					}
   171				} else if !strings.HasPrefix(text, ":") {
   172					field, value, _ := strings.Cut(text, ":")
   173					value = strings.TrimPrefix(value, " ")
   174					switch field {
   175					case "id":
   176						id = value
   177					case "event":
   178						event = value
   179					case "data":
   180						// SSE joins every data line of a block into one payload, so
   181						// the cap applies to their total, not to each line.
   182						if data.Len()+1+len(value) > maxSSELineSize {
   183							skipBlock = true
   184						} else {
   185							if hasData {
   186								data.WriteString("\n")
   187							}
   188							data.WriteString(value)
   189							hasData = true
   190						}
   191					}
   192				}
   193			}
   194			if err != nil {
   195				if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   196					dispatch()
   197					return nil
   198				}
   199				return err
   200			}
   201		}
   202	}
   203	
   204	// sseData keeps a data payload as JSON. Every payload observed is a JSON
   205	// object; anything else is preserved as a JSON string so no content is lost.
   206	func sseData(text string, hasData bool) json.RawMessage {
   207		if !hasData {
   208			return nil
   209		}
   210		if json.Valid([]byte(text)) {
   211			return json.RawMessage(text)
   212		}
   213		quoted, _ := json.Marshal(text)
   214		return quoted
   215	}
   216	
   217	// eventsAreWhole reports whether a run's recorded events end with the done
   218	// event, which the stream sends only after the run's final result.
   219	func eventsAreWhole(events []sseEvent) bool {
   220		return len(events) > 0 && events[len(events)-1].Event == "done"
   221	}
   222	
   223	// encodeEvents renders events as JSONL for the mirror. HTML escaping is off
   224	// so the stored data keeps the stream's bytes (json.Marshal would rewrite
   225	// "&&" in a shell command as "&&").
   226	func encodeEvents(events []sseEvent) ([]byte, error) {
   227		var buf bytes.Buffer
   228		enc := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
   229		enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
   230		for _, event := range events {
   231			// Encode terminates each record with the newline JSONL needs.
   232			if err := enc.Encode(event); err != nil {
   233				return nil, err
   234			}
   235		}
   236		return buf.Bytes(), nil
   237	}
   238	
   239	// readEventsFile reads a run's mirrored events. A missing file is no events.
   240	// Malformed or oversized lines are skipped with a warning so one bad record
   241	// costs one event, not the run.
   242	func readEventsFile(path string) ([]sseEvent, error) {
   243		f, err := os.Open(path)
   244		if err != nil {
   245			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
   246				return nil, nil
   247			}
   248			return nil, err
   249		}
   250		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
   251	
   252		var events []sseEvent
   253		reader := bufio.NewReader(f)
   254		for lineNo := 1; ; lineNo++ {
   255			line, oversized, err := spi.ReadRecordLine(reader, spi.MaxRecordLineSize)
   256			if oversized {
   257				slog.Warn("Skipping oversized JSONL line", "file", path, "line", lineNo)
   258			} else if trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(line); len(trimmed) > 0 {
   259				var event sseEvent
   260				if jsonErr := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &event); jsonErr != nil || event.Event == "" {
   261					slog.Warn("Skipping corrupted JSONL line", "file", path, "line", lineNo, "error", jsonErr)
   262				} else {
   263					events = append(events, event)
   264				}
   265			}
   266			if err != nil {
   267				if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
   268					return events, nil
   269				}
   270				return events, err
   271			}
   272		}
   273	}
   274	
   275	// eventTime converts an SSE id ("<epochMillis>-<seq>") to an RFC 3339 UTC
   276	// timestamp. The id is the only timestamp the stream carries. Returns "" when
   277	// the id is absent (status events carry none) or malformed.
   278	func eventTime(id string) string {
   279		t, ok := eventInstant(id)
   280		if !ok {
   281			return ""
   282		}
   283		return spi.RFC3339Millis(t)
   284	}
   285	
   286	// eventInstant parses the epoch-millisecond prefix of an SSE id.
   287	func eventInstant(id string) (time.Time, bool) {
   288		millis, _, _ := strings.Cut(id, "-")
   289		ms, err := strconv.ParseInt(millis, 10, 64)
   290		if err != nil || ms <= 0 {
   291			return time.Time{}, false
   292		}
   293		return time.UnixMilli(ms).UTC(), true
   294	}
   295	
   296	// validAgentID and validRunID guard ids before they become mirror path
   297	// components; ids come from the network and are untrusted. Observed shapes are
   298	// bc-<uuid> and run-<uuid>.
   299	func validAgentID(id string) bool { return validPrefixedID(id, "bc-") }
   300	func validRunID(id string) bool   { return validPrefixedID(id, "run-") }
   301	
   302	func validPrefixedID(id, prefix string) bool {
   303		rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(id, prefix)
   304		if !ok || rest == "" || len(rest) > 64 {
   305			return false
   306		}
   307		for _, r := range rest {
   308			isHex := (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || (r >= 'a' && r <= 'f') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'F')
   309			if !isHex && r != '-' {
   310				return false
   311			}
   312		}
   313		return true
   314	}

     1	package cursorcloud
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"context"
     5		"errors"
     6		"fmt"
     7		"log/slog"
     8		"os"
     9		"os/exec"
    10		"os/signal"
    11		"runtime"
    12		"syscall"
    13	
    14		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
    15	)
    16	
    17	// dashboardURL is where cloud agents are launched and followed.
    18	const dashboardURL = "https://cursor.com/agents"
    19	
    20	// ExecAgentAndWatch is `run` for a hosted agent. No local process exists, so
    21	// it opens the cloud agents dashboard (or one agent's page when resuming) with
    22	// the configured opener and then watches until Ctrl-C exactly like WatchAgent.
    23	func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
    24		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: starting", "projectPath", projectPath, "customCommand", customCommand, "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID, "debugRaw", debugRaw)
    25	
    26		target := dashboardURL
    27		if resumeSessionID != "" {
    28			if validAgentID(resumeSessionID) {
    29				target = dashboardURL + "/" + resumeSessionID
    30			} else {
    31				slog.Warn("ExecAgentAndWatch: ignoring malformed agent id", "resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID)
    32			}
    33		}
    34		if err := openURL(customCommand, target); err != nil {
    35			// Watching still works when the browser could not be opened; the
    36			// user can follow the printed URL.
    37			slog.Warn("ExecAgentAndWatch: opening the dashboard failed", "url", target, "error", err)
    38			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Could not open %s (%v). Open it in a browser; watching for Cursor Cloud Agent activity — press Ctrl-C to stop.\n", target, err)
    39		} else {
    40			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Opened %s — watching for Cursor Cloud Agent activity, press Ctrl-C to stop.\n", target)
    41		}
    42	
    43		ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
    44		defer cancel()
    45		err := p.WatchAgent(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
    46		if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
    47			err = nil
    48		}
    49		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: exiting", "error", err)
    50		return err
    51	}
    52	
    53	// openURL runs the opener with url appended. The default is the platform's
    54	// URL handler; a custom command (cursorcloud_cmd or -c) replaces it.
    55	func openURL(customCommand, url string) error {
    56		args := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
    57		if len(args) == 0 {
    58			args = defaultOpener()
    59		}
    60		if len(args) == 0 {
    61			return fmt.Errorf("no URL opener for %s", runtime.GOOS)
    62		}
    63		cmd := exec.Command(args[0], append(args[1:], url)...)
    64		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: opening dashboard", "command", args[0], "url", url)
    65		return cmd.Run()
    66	}
    67	
    68	// defaultOpener is the platform's own URL handler.
    69	func defaultOpener() []string {
    70		switch runtime.GOOS {
    71		case "darwin":
    72			return []string{"open"}
    73		case "windows":
    74			return []string{"rundll32", "url.dll,FileProtocolHandler"}
    75		default:
    76			return []string{"xdg-open"}
    77		}
    78	}
    79	
    80	// WatchAgent polls for cloud agent activity on this project's repository and
    81	// delivers each new or updated session until ctx is cancelled, or until the
    82	// API refuses the agent listing permanently (rejected key, Privacy Mode), which
    83	// is returned as an error so `run` and `watch` report it instead of hanging.
    84	func (p *Provider) WatchAgent(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
    85		slog.Info("WatchAgent: starting Cursor Cloud Agent polling", "projectPath", projectPath, "debugRaw", debugRaw)
    86		key, source := resolveAPIKey()
    87		if key == "" {
    88			slog.Info("WatchAgent: no API key configured")
    89			return errors.New("no Cursor API key: set CURSOR_API_KEY or cursor_api_key under [providers] in specstory.toml")
    90		}
    91		origin := projectOrigin(projectPath)
    92		if origin == "" {
    93			slog.Info("WatchAgent: project has no git origin", "projectPath", projectPath)
    94			return noProjectOriginError(projectPath)
    95		}
    96	
    97		watcher := newCloudWatcher(projectPath, origin, newAPIClient(key), debugRaw, sessionCallback)
    98		watcher.start(ctx)
    99		slog.Info("WatchAgent: polling", "origin", origin, "keySource", source, "mirror", watcher.mirror.root, "interval", pollInterval)
   100	
   101		var err error
   102		select {
   103		case <-ctx.Done():
   104			err = ctx.Err()
   105			slog.Info("WatchAgent: context cancelled, stopping")
   106		case err = <-watcher.fatal:
   107			slog.Error("WatchAgent: the API refused the agent listing; stopping", "error", err)
   108		}
   109		watcher.stop()
   110		slog.Info("WatchAgent: stopped")
   111		return err
   112	}

    15	
    16	// Watcher tuning. A remote store has no filesystem events, so a poll of the
    17	// agent list is the change signal. Variables so tests can run in milliseconds.
    18	var (
    19		// pollInterval keeps the poll (one request per page) far inside the
    20		// 20-requests-per-minute budget, leaving room for refreshes and streams.
    21		pollInterval = 60 * time.Second
    22		// emitDebounce coalesces a burst of stream events into one save; the
    23		// burst's last event is usually the completed text.
    24		emitDebounce = 2 * time.Second
    25		// reconnectDelay is the first wait before reattaching a dropped stream.
    26		reconnectDelay = 5 * time.Second
    27	)
    28	
    29	const (
    30		// maxLiveStreams bounds concurrent stream connections; each holds a
    31		// connection open for the length of a run.
    32		maxLiveStreams = 4
    33		// maxStreamReconnects bounds reattaching one dropped stream.
    34		maxStreamReconnects = 5
    35		// maxPollPages bounds the agents scanned per poll. The list is newest
    36		// first, so 300 agents covers any agent a person is actively running.
    37		maxPollPages = 3
    38	)
    39	
    40	// cloudWatcher polls the agent list and follows running runs live.
    41	type cloudWatcher struct {
    42		origin       string
    43		projectPath  string
    44		mirror       mirror
    45		projectLocal bool
    46		client       *apiClient
    47		debugRaw     bool
    48		callback     func(*spi.AgentChatSession)
    49	
    50		ctx       context.Context
    51		cancel    context.CancelFunc
    52		startedAt time.Time
    53	
    54		mu      sync.Mutex
    55		seen    map[string]string // agent id -> updatedAt last refreshed successfully
    56		startup map[string]string // agent id -> updatedAt listed during the baseline
    57		live    map[string]bool   // run ids with an attached stream
    58		pending map[string]bool   // agent ids queued for emission
    59		emitCh  chan string
    60		fatal   chan error // the one error that ends the watch; see pollLoop
    61	
    62		workers  sync.WaitGroup // poll loop and stream followers
    63		emitter  sync.WaitGroup // the single delivery worker
    64		stopOnce sync.Once
    65	}
    66	
    67	func newCloudWatcher(projectPath, origin string, client *apiClient, debugRaw bool, callback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) *cloudWatcher {
    68		m, projectLocal := mirrorFor(projectPath)
    69		return &cloudWatcher{
    70			origin:       origin,
    71			projectPath:  projectPath,
    72			mirror:       m,
    73			projectLocal: projectLocal,
    74			client:       client,
    75			debugRaw:     debugRaw,
    76			callback:     callback,
    77			seen:         map[string]string{},
    78			startup:      map[string]string{},
    79			live:         map[string]bool{},
    80			pending:      map[string]bool{},
    81		}
    82	}
    83	
    84	// start begins polling. The context is created per start so a stopped
    85	// watcher can be started again.
    86	func (w *cloudWatcher) start(parent context.Context) {
    87		w.ctx, w.cancel = context.WithCancel(parent)
    88		w.startedAt = time.Now()
    89		w.emitCh = make(chan string, 64)
    90		w.fatal = make(chan error, 1)
    91		w.stopOnce = sync.Once{}
    92		w.emitter.Go(w.emitLoop)
    93		w.workers.Go(w.pollLoop)
    94	}
    95	
    96	// stop cancels polling and streams, waits for every follower to write its
    97	// final events and queue any update not yet delivered, then drains delivery.
    98	func (w *cloudWatcher) stop() {
    99		w.stopOnce.Do(func() {
   100			w.cancel()
   101			w.workers.Wait()
   102			close(w.emitCh)
   103			w.emitter.Wait()
   104		})
   105	}
   106	
   107	// pollLoop runs the baseline poll, then polls every pollInterval. It ends with
   108	// the context, or when the API refuses the listing for good: a rejected key or
   109	// an account on Privacy Mode fails every poll the same way, and polling on
   110	// would leave `run` and `watch` claiming to watch while nothing can ever be
   111	// saved. That error is handed to WatchAgent through fatal.
   112	func (w *cloudWatcher) pollLoop() {
   113		baseline := true
   114		for {
   115			listed, err := w.poll(baseline)
   116			if err != nil {
   117				w.fatal <- err
   118				return
   119			}
   120			if listed {
   121				baseline = false
   122			}
   123			if sleepContext(w.ctx, pollInterval) != nil {
   124				return
   125			}
   126		}
   127	}
   128	
   129	// poll lists agents and acts on the ones for this project. The baseline poll
   130	// mirrors whatever is new but emits nothing: existing sessions are not news
   131	// because the watcher started. Afterwards an agent seen for the first time or
   132	// whose updatedAt moved is refreshed and emitted. An agent changing during the
   133	// baseline is caught by the next poll, because the baseline records the
   134	// updatedAt it listed, not what the agent became. The first result reports
   135	// whether the listing succeeded: pollLoop keeps the baseline open until it has,
   136	// so a failed first poll cannot turn every pre-existing agent into news. The
   137	// error is set only when the listing was refused permanently (a 4xx other than
   138	// 429); transport, 429 and 5xx failures are retried on the next poll.
   139	//
   140	// "Listed at startup" and "refreshed" are tracked apart. seen records only
   141	// refreshes that succeeded, so an agent whose baseline refresh failed is
   142	// retried on every poll until its mirror is filled; startup remembers the
   143	// updatedAt the baseline listed, so those retries stay silent while nothing
   144	// about the agent has changed, and become news once it has.
   145	func (w *cloudWatcher) poll(baseline bool) (bool, error) {
   146		agents, err := w.client.listAgents(w.ctx, maxPollPages)
   147		if err != nil {
   148			if w.ctx.Err() != nil {
   149				return false, nil
   150			}
   151			if permanentAPIError(err) {
   152				return false, fmt.Errorf("listing cloud agents: %w", err)
   153			}
   154			slog.Warn("WatchAgent: listing cloud agents failed; retrying next poll", "error", err)
   155			return false, nil
   156		}
   157		for _, record := range agents {
   158			if w.ctx.Err() != nil {
   159				return false, nil
   160			}
   161			agent := record.agent
   162			if !agentMatchesOrigin(agent, w.origin) {
   163				continue
   164			}
   165			w.mu.Lock()
   166			prev, known := w.seen[agent.ID]
   167			if baseline {
   168				w.startup[agent.ID] = agent.UpdatedAt
   169			}
   170			// Quiet while the agent is exactly as the baseline listed it, even if
   171			// that baseline refresh failed and this is a retry.
   172			quiet := baseline || w.startup[agent.ID] == agent.UpdatedAt
   173			skip := w.liveSnapshot()
   174			w.mu.Unlock()
   175			if known && prev == agent.UpdatedAt {
   176				continue
   177			}
   178	
   179			if err := w.mirror.ensureRoot(w.projectLocal); err != nil {
   180				slog.Error("WatchAgent: cannot create mirror", "path", w.mirror.root, "error", err)
   181				return false, nil
   182			}
   183			if err := w.mirror.refreshAgent(w.ctx, w.client, record, refreshOptions{skipStreams: skip, now: time.Now()}); err != nil {
   184				if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
   185					slog.Error("WatchAgent: refreshing cloud agent failed; retrying next poll", "agentId", agent.ID, "error", err)
   186				}
   187				continue
   188			}
   189			w.mu.Lock()
   190			w.seen[agent.ID] = agent.UpdatedAt
   191			w.mu.Unlock()
   192			if quiet {
   193				slog.Debug("WatchAgent: baseline", "agentId", agent.ID, "updatedAt", agent.UpdatedAt)
   194			} else {
   195				slog.Info("WatchAgent: cloud agent updated", "agentId", agent.ID, "updatedAt", agent.UpdatedAt)
   196				w.enqueue(agent.ID)
   197			}
   198		}
   199		w.attachRunning()
   200		return true, nil
   201	}
   202	
   203	// liveSnapshot copies the attached-run set; callers hold w.mu.
   204	func (w *cloudWatcher) liveSnapshot() map[string]bool {
   205		return maps.Clone(w.live)
   206	}
   207	
   208	// attachRunning starts a follower for every unfinished run in this project's
   209	// mirror that has none, up to maxLiveStreams.
   210	func (w *cloudWatcher) attachRunning() {
   211		for _, snap := range w.mirror.matchingSnapshots(w.origin) {
   212			for _, run := range snap.runs {
   213				if run.run.isTerminal() {
   214					continue
   215				}
   216				w.mu.Lock()
   217				attach := !w.live[run.run.ID] && len(w.live) < maxLiveStreams && w.ctx.Err() == nil
   218				if attach {
   219					w.live[run.run.ID] = true
   220				}
   221				w.mu.Unlock()
   222				if !attach {
   223					continue
   224				}
   225				agentID, runID := snap.agent.ID, run.run.ID
   226				slog.Info("WatchAgent: following live run", "agentId", agentID, "runId", runID)
   227				w.workers.Go(func() {
   228					w.followRun(agentID, runID)
   229					w.mu.Lock()
   230					delete(w.live, runID)
   231					w.mu.Unlock()
   232				})
   233			}
   234		}
   235	}
   236	
   237	// followRun streams a run into its events file until the run ends or the
   238	// watcher stops. Events are flushed and the session queued for delivery after
   239	// each burst (debounced), once more when the run ends, and on stop if an
   240	// update is still undelivered. Only events stamped after the watcher started
   241	// count as activity: attaching replays the run from its start.
   242	func (w *cloudWatcher) followRun(agentID, runID string) {
   243		events, err := readEventsFile(w.mirror.eventsFile(agentID, runID))
   244		if err != nil {
   245			slog.Error("WatchAgent: reading mirrored events failed", "runId", runID, "error", err)
   246			return
   247		}
   248		if eventsAreWhole(events) {
   249			return
   250		}
   251		undelivered := false
   252		flush := func() {
   253			if err := w.mirror.writeEvents(agentID, runID, events); err != nil {
   254				slog.Error("WatchAgent: writing events failed", "runId", runID, "error", err)
   255			}
   256			if undelivered {
   257				w.enqueue(agentID)
   258				undelivered = false
   259			}
   260		}
   261	
   262		done := false
   263		delay := reconnectDelay
   264		for attempt := 0; !done && w.ctx.Err() == nil && attempt <= maxStreamReconnects; attempt++ {
   265			lastID := lastEventID(events)
   266			body, err := w.client.openStream(w.ctx, agentID, runID, lastID)
   267			if errors.Is(err, errStreamExpired) {
   268				slog.Info("WatchAgent: run stream expired", "runId", runID)
   269				break
   270			}
   271			if err != nil {
   272				if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
   273					slog.Warn("WatchAgent: stream connect failed", "runId", runID, "attempt", attempt+1, "error", err)
   274					_ = sleepContext(w.ctx, delay)
   275					delay = min(delay*2, maxBackoff)
   276				}
   277				continue
   278			}
   279	
   280			// A resumed stream may repeat events carrying the resume id: ids are
   281			// not unique (a thinking event and its interaction_update share one).
   282			repeats := eventsWithID(events, lastID)
   283			incoming := make(chan sseEvent)
   284			var reader sync.WaitGroup
   285			var readErr error
   286			reader.Go(func() {
   287				defer close(incoming)
   288				readErr = readSSE(body, agentID+"/"+runID, func(ev sseEvent) bool {
   289					select {
   290					case incoming <- ev:
   291						return ev.Event != "done"
   292					case <-w.ctx.Done():
   293						return false
   294					}
   295				})
   296			})
   297	
   298			debounce := time.NewTimer(emitDebounce)
   299			debounce.Stop()
   300		receive:
   301			for {
   302				select {
   303				case ev, ok := <-incoming:
   304					if !ok {
   305						break receive
   306					}
   307					if lastID != "" && ev.ID == lastID && repeats[eventKey(ev)] {
   308						continue
   309					}
   310					events = append(events, ev)
   311					if t, ok := eventInstant(ev.ID); ok && !t.Before(w.startedAt) {
   312						undelivered = true
   313					}
   314					if ev.Event == "done" {
   315						done = true
   316					}
   317					debounce.Reset(emitDebounce)
   318				case <-debounce.C:
   319					flush()
   320				case <-w.ctx.Done():
   321					break receive
   322				}
   323			}
   324			debounce.Stop()
   325			_ = body.Close()
   326			reader.Wait()
   327			if readErr != nil && w.ctx.Err() == nil && !done {
   328				slog.Warn("WatchAgent: stream dropped; reconnecting", "runId", runID, "error", readErr)
   329			}
   330		}
   331	
   332		if done {
   333			// The run object now says how the run ended; fetch it so the exchange
   334			// carries the final status and branch.
   335			if runs, err := w.client.listRuns(w.ctx, agentID); err == nil {
   336				for _, run := range runs {
   337					if err := writeFileAtomic(w.mirror.runFile(agentID, run.run.ID), run.raw); err != nil {
   338						slog.Error("WatchAgent: writing run failed", "runId", run.run.ID, "error", err)
   339					}
   340				}
   341			} else if w.ctx.Err() == nil {
   342				slog.Warn("WatchAgent: refreshing finished run failed", "runId", runID, "error", err)
   343			}
   344			slog.Info("WatchAgent: live run finished", "agentId", agentID, "runId", runID)
   345		}
   346		flush()
   347	}
   348	
   349	// lastEventID returns the id of the last event that carries one.
   350	func lastEventID(events []sseEvent) string {
   351		for i := len(events) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
   352			if events[i].ID != "" {
   353				return events[i].ID
   354			}
   355		}
   356		return ""
   357	}
   358	
   359	// eventsWithID returns the identities of recorded events with the given id.
   360	func eventsWithID(events []sseEvent, id string) map[string]bool {
   361		set := map[string]bool{}
   362		if id == "" {
   363			return set
   364		}
   365		for _, ev := range events {
   366			if ev.ID == id {
   367				set[eventKey(ev)] = true
   368			}
   369		}
   370		return set
   371	}
   372	
   373	func eventKey(ev sseEvent) string {
   374		data, _ := json.Marshal(ev)
   375		return string(data)
   376	}
   377	
   378	// enqueue queues an agent for delivery, coalescing repeats still waiting.
   379	func (w *cloudWatcher) enqueue(agentID string) {
   380		w.mu.Lock()
   381		if w.pending[agentID] {
   382			w.mu.Unlock()
   383			return
   384		}
   385		w.pending[agentID] = true
   386		w.mu.Unlock()
   387		w.emitCh <- agentID
   388	}
   389	
   390	// emitLoop delivers sessions one at a time, in queue order, from the mirror.
   391	func (w *cloudWatcher) emitLoop() {
   392		for agentID := range w.emitCh {
   393			w.mu.Lock()
   394			delete(w.pending, agentID)
   395			w.mu.Unlock()
   396			snap, err := loadAgentSnapshot(w.mirror.agentDir(agentID))
   397			if err != nil || snap == nil {
   398				slog.Warn("WatchAgent: cannot read mirrored agent", "agentId", agentID, "error", err)
   399				continue
   400			}
   401			session := convertSnapshot(snap, w.projectPath, w.debugRaw)
   402			if session == nil {
   403				continue
   404			}
   405			spi.DeliverSession("WatchAgent", w.callback, session)
   406		}
   407	}

    31	// toolType classifies a tool by the name recorded in tool_call events. Every

    55	// cleanToolInput returns a copy of the recorded args without plumbing keys.
    56	// Shell noise stays in the stored Input (it is real data) and is only hidden

    58	func cleanToolInput(args map[string]any) map[string]any {

   201	// labeledLines renders the given keys, in order, as "Label: value" lines.
   202	// Path-valued labels are shown relative to the VM workspace.
   203	func labeledLines(in map[string]any, keys [][2]string) string {

   351		default:
   352			return formatGenericResult(tool.Output)
   353		}
   354	}
   355	
   356	// toolErrorText extracts a failed call's message. Observed shapes:
   357	// {"error":{"error":"..."}} (delete_file, grep_search, web_fetch) and
   358	// {"error":{"errorMessage":"..."}} (read_file). An error object with neither
   359	// key is shown as JSON rather than dropped.
   360	func toolErrorText(output map[string]any) string {
   361		errObj, ok := output["error"]
   362		if !ok {
   363			return ""
   364		}
   365		m, ok := errObj.(map[string]any)
   366		if !ok {
   367			if s, isString := errObj.(string); isString {
   368				return s
   369			}
   370			return compactJSON(errObj)
   371		}
   372		if text := spi.StringValue(m, "error", "errorMessage", "message"); text != "" {
   373			return text
   374		}
   375		return compactJSON(m)
   376	}
   377	
   378	// formatShellResult renders command output. A non-zero exit is recorded as a
   379	// "failure" branch with exitCode and stderr; success carries stdout. The
   380	// interleaved stream is preferred because it keeps stdout and stderr in the
   381	// order the terminal showed them.
   382	func formatShellResult(output map[string]any) string {
   383		var b strings.Builder
   384		branch := resultBranch(output, "success")
   385		if failure := resultBranch(output, "failure"); failure != nil {
   386			branch = failure
   387			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Exit code: %s\n\n", spi.StringValue(failure, "exitCode"))
   388		}
   389		if branch == nil {
   390			return formatGenericResult(output)
   391		}
   392		if background, _ := output["isBackground"].(bool); background {
   393			b.WriteString("Running in the background.\n\n")
   394		}
   395		text := spi.StringValue(branch, "interleavedOutput")
   396		if text == "" {
   397			text = spi.StringValue(branch, "stdout") + spi.StringValue(branch, "stderr")
   398		}
   399		text = strings.Trim(spi.SanitizeShellOutput(text), "\n")
   400		if text == "" {
   401			b.WriteString("Result: (no output)")
   402			return b.String()
   403		}
   404		b.WriteString("Result:\n")
   405		b.WriteString(spi.CodeFence("text", spi.CapRunes(text, maxResultRunes)))
   406		return b.String()
   407	}
   408	
   409	// formatReadResult fences the file content by the file's language and notes
   410	// when only part of the file was read.
   411	func formatReadResult(in, success map[string]any) string {
   412		content := spi.StringValue(success, "content")
   413		if content == "" {
   414			return "Result: (empty file)"
   415		}
   416		var b strings.Builder
   417		if rng, ok := success["readRange"].(map[string]any); ok {
   418			start, end := spi.StringValue(rng, "startLine"), spi.StringValue(rng, "endLine")
   419			total := spi.StringValue(success, "totalLines")
   420			if start != "" && end != "" && (start != "1" || end != total) {
   421				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Lines %s–%s of %s\n\n", start, end, total)
   422			}
   423		}
   424		path := spi.StringValue(in, "path")
   425		b.WriteString(spi.CodeFence(spi.LanguageFromPath(path), spi.CapRunes(strings.TrimRight(content, "\n"), maxResultRunes)))
   426		return b.String()
   427	}
   428	
   429	// formatFileSearchResult lists matched files.
   430	func formatFileSearchResult(success map[string]any) string {
   431		files, _ := success["files"].([]any)
   432		if len(files) == 0 {
   433			return "Result: no files found"
   434		}
   435		var b strings.Builder
   436		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Result: %d %s\n", len(files), plural(len(files), "file", "files"))
   437		for _, f := range files {
   438			if name, ok := f.(string); ok {
   439				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", spi.InlineCode(name))
   440			}
   441		}
   442		return b.String()
   443	}
   444	
   445	// formatGrepResult flattens workspaceResults into file:line: text lines. The
   446	// map is keyed by workspace root; roots are sorted so output is deterministic.
   447	func formatGrepResult(success map[string]any) string {
   448		roots, _ := success["workspaceResults"].(map[string]any)
   449		var lines []string
   450		for _, root := range sortedKeys(roots) {
   451			rootResult, _ := roots[root].(map[string]any)
   452			content, _ := rootResult["content"].(map[string]any)
   453			files, _ := content["matches"].([]any)
   454			for _, f := range files {
   455				file, ok := f.(map[string]any)
   456				if !ok {
   457					continue
   458				}
   459				name := spi.StringValue(file, "file")
   460				matches, _ := file["matches"].([]any)
   461				for _, m := range matches {
   462					match, ok := m.(map[string]any)
   463					if !ok {
   464						continue
   465					}
   466					lines = append(lines, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s: %s", name, spi.StringValue(match, "lineNumber"), spi.StringValue(match, "content")))
   467				}
   468			}
   469		}
   470		if len(lines) == 0 {
   471			if roots == nil {
   472				return formatGenericResult(map[string]any{"success": success})
   473			}
   474			return "Result: no matches"
   475		}
   476		return "Result:\n" + spi.CodeFence("text", spi.CapRunes(strings.Join(lines, "\n"), maxResultRunes))
   477	}
   478	
   479	// formatWebSearchResult renders each reference. The chunk is already a
   480	// markdown link list followed by a synthesis paragraph, so it is shown as is.
   481	func formatWebSearchResult(success map[string]any) string {
   482		refs, _ := success["references"].([]any)
   483		var b strings.Builder
   484		for _, r := range refs {
   485			ref, ok := r.(map[string]any)
   486			if !ok {
   487				continue
   488			}
   489			chunk := strings.TrimSpace(spi.StringValue(ref, "chunk"))
   490			if chunk == "" {
   491				continue
   492			}
   493			if b.Len() > 0 {
   494				b.WriteString("\n\n")
   495			}
   496			// The chunk's trailing "Highlights:" section quotes page excerpts in
   497			// <result><title><url><content> tags, which markdown would read as
   498			// HTML; it is fenced so the excerpts survive as text.
   499			links, highlights, found := strings.Cut(chunk, "\n\nHighlights:\n")
   500			b.WriteString(spi.CapRunes(links, maxResultRunes))
   501			if found && strings.TrimSpace(highlights) != "" {
   502				b.WriteString("\n\nHighlights:\n")
   503				b.WriteString(spi.CodeFence("text", spi.CapRunes(strings.TrimSpace(highlights), maxResultRunes)))
   504			}
   505		}
   506		if b.Len() == 0 {
   507			return formatGenericResult(map[string]any{"success": success})
   508		}
   509		return "Result:\n\n" + b.String()
   510	}
   511	
   512	// formatMCPResult shows the text content parts. structuredContent repeats the
   513	// text in every observed result, so it is shown only when there is no text.
   514	func formatMCPResult(success map[string]any) string {
   515		parts, _ := success["content"].([]any)
   516		var texts []string
   517		for _, p := range parts {
   518			part, ok := p.(map[string]any)
   519			if !ok {
   520				continue
   521			}
   522			if textObj, ok := part["text"].(map[string]any); ok {
   523				if text := spi.StringValue(textObj, "text"); text != "" {
   524					texts = append(texts, text)
   525				}
   526			}
   527		}
   528		if len(texts) == 0 {
   529			return formatGenericResult(map[string]any{"success": success})
   530		}
   531		return "Result:\n" + spi.CodeFence("text", spi.CapRunes(strings.Join(texts, "\n\n"), maxResultRunes))
   532	}
   533	
   534	// formatMCPToolsResult shows a tool schema lookup. The content is a JSON
   535	// string (a schema, or a note that output went to a file).
   536	func formatMCPToolsResult(success map[string]any) string {

   539		if path := spi.StringValue(success, "outputFilePath"); path != "" {
   540			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Output file: %s\n\n", spi.InlineCode(path))
   541		}
   542		if content != "" {
   543			lang := "text"
   544			if json.Valid([]byte(content)) {
   545				lang = "json"
   546			}
   547			b.WriteString("Result:\n")
   548			b.WriteString(spi.CodeFence(lang, spi.CapRunes(content, maxResultRunes)))
   549		}
   550		return b.String()
   551	}
   552	
   553	// formatCanvasResult links the canvas and shows its source when returned.
   554	func formatCanvasResult(success map[string]any) string {
   555		var b strings.Builder
   556		title := spi.StringValue(success, "title")
   557		if url := spi.StringValue(success, "url"); url != "" {
   558			if title == "" {
   559				title = url
   560			}
   561			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Result: [%s](%s)\n", markdownLinkTextEscaper.Replace(title), url)
   562		}
   563		if source := spi.StringValue(success, "source"); source != "" {
   564			b.WriteString("\n")
   565			b.WriteString(spi.CodeFence("jsx", spi.CapRunes(source, maxResultRunes)))
   566		}

   568	}

   570	// formatGenericResult is the fallback for an unfamiliar result shape.
   571	func formatGenericResult(output map[string]any) string {

   579	// resultBlock renders a labeled one-line or fenced multi-line result.
   580	func resultBlock(label, text string) string {
   581		text = strings.TrimSpace(text)
   582		if strings.Contains(text, "\n") {
   583			return label + ":\n" + spi.CodeFence("text", spi.CapRunes(text, maxResultRunes))
   584		}
   585		return label + ": " + text
   586	}

   589	func resultBranch(output map[string]any, key string) map[string]any {
   590		branch, _ := output[key].(map[string]any)
   591		return branch
   592	}

   598	func compactJSON(v any) string {
   599		data, err := json.Marshal(v)

   601			return ""
   602		}

   604	}

   607		keys := make([]string, 0, len(m))
   608		for k := range m {

   610		}
   611		sort.Strings(keys)
   612		return keys
   613	}

   617			return one
   618		}
   619		return many

+// tightenUserConfigMode strips group and other permission bits from the user
+// config, because it can hold credentials such as cursor_api_key. Files created
+// by earlier releases are 0644, and os.WriteFile keeps an existing file's mode,
+// so creation-time permissions alone would leave upgraded installs readable by
+// other local users. Only the user config is touched: a project config is shared
+// with the project on purpose, and its permissions belong to the repository.
+// Windows has no POSIX mode bits (Chmod there only toggles read-only), so the
+// file is left alone.
+func tightenUserConfigMode(path string) {
+	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
+		return
+	}
+	info, err := os.Stat(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		return
+	}
+	perm := info.Mode().Perm()
+	if perm&0o077 == 0 {
+		return
+	}
+	if err := os.Chmod(path, perm&^0o077); err != nil {
+		slog.Debug("Could not tighten user config permissions", "path", path, "error", err)
+		return
+	}
+	slog.Debug("Tightened user config permissions", "path", path, "was", perm.String())
+}

func TestDebugOutput(t *testing.T) {
	debugBase := t.TempDir()
	spi.SetDebugBaseDir(debugBase)
	t.Cleanup(func() { spi.SetDebugBaseDir("") })

	snap := snapshotFromFixture(t, "failure-run")
	dir := spi.GetDebugDir(snap.agent.ID)
	if !strings.HasPrefix(dir, debugBase) {
		t.Fatalf("debug dir %s ignores --debug-dir", dir)
	}

	t.Run("flag off writes nothing", func(t *testing.T) {
		if convertSnapshot(snap, testWorkspace, false) == nil {
			t.Fatal("no session")
		}
		if _, err := os.Stat(dir); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Errorf("debug dir exists without the flag: %v", err)
		}
	})

	// Seed a CLI-owned file and a stale run file from a longer earlier export.
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stale := filepath.Join(dir, "run-3-run-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.json")
	cliOwned := filepath.Join(dir, "session-data.json")
	for _, path := range []string{stale, cliOwned} {
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte("{}"), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)

	for _, name := range []string{"agent.json", "conversation.json", "usage.json",

			t.Errorf("missing %s: %v", name, err)

	if _, err := os.Stat(stale); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		t.Error("stale run-3 debug file survived the refresh")

	agentJSON, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "agent.json"))

    13	# which an unattended factory job must not launch.

    15	# Factory SPI contract: print the current released version to stdout and exit 0.
    16	# Non-zero exit means "sensor failure", never "no change". Output is opaque to
    17	# the factory — byte-compared against the stored reading, never parsed.
    18	set -euo pipefail
    19	# awk reads the whole document (no early exit) so curl never sees a closed
    20	# pipe, which pipefail would report as a sensor failure.
    21	version=$(curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 --retry 2 --retry-delay 2 https://cursor.com/docs-static/cloud-agents-openapi.yaml \
    22	  | awk '/^info:/ { in_info = 1; next } in_info && /^[^ ]/ { in_info = 0 } in_info && !found && $1 == "version:" { print $2; found = 1 }' \
    23	  | tr -d "\"'")
    24	if [ -z "$version" ]; then
    25	  echo "could not read info.version from cloud-agents-openapi.yaml (document format changed?)" >&2
    26	  exit 1
    27	fi
    28	printf '%s\n' "$version"

// UserMessage prints a plain message to stderr without any prefix or color
// This respects the silent flag - no output if silent mode is enabled
func UserMessage(format string, args ...interface{}) {
	if !isSilent() {
		message := fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
		fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, message)
	}
}

// UserWarn prints a warning message to stderr with orange color
// This respects the silent flag - no output if silent mode is enabled
func UserWarn(format string, args ...interface{}) {
	if !isSilent() {
		message := fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\n%sWarning: %s\n%s", ColorOrange, message, ColorReset)
	}
}

// UserError prints an error message to stderr with bright red color
// This respects the silent flag - no output if silent mode is enabled
